text:
ben_sales: Heads-up — FinBank wants a 2-week on-prem POC for Redwood Private starting next Wed. They have 4x A100s behind a locked-down VPC, air-gapped by default. They asked for an install prereq checklist, validation commands we can share with their infra team, and whether we can give a temporary hosted API key for fallback testing. Who can own the pre-check and cert/KMS questions?

alice_finbank: hey — i can run checks from our side. k8s is managed by our infra team (rke2), currently on v1.25. Container runtime is containerd. No outbound internet from prod nodes; we can enable a mirror host. We have an internal KMS (HashiCorp Vault) and can open ports to a bastion.

raj_eng_infra: OK copying checklist here, quick summary first: k8s + CRI compatibility, nvidia driver + CUDA reqs, nvidia-device-plugin and container toolkit, kernel headers, storage (CSI), networking (DNS, NAT), control-plane accessibility, certs and KMS, and optionally offline artifact mirror. I'll own pre-checks with alice.

lena_field_se: Adding list we give to customers (short form) — shareable w/ FinBank infra: 
- Kubernetes: 1.24–1.27 supported (we've validated 1.25/1.26). kubeadm/rke2/eks/gke ok but must allow hostNetwork for installer.
- Container runtime: containerd or docker, containerd >= 1.6 recommended. Ensure CRI socket path accessible to installer.
- GPU drivers: NVIDIA driver >= 525.x for A100, CUDA 11.8+ recommended. Run `nvidia-smi` to verify.
- NVIDIA Container Toolkit & device-plugin: install `nvidia-container-toolkit` and the nvidia-device-plugin daemonset.
- Kernel headers: matching kernel headers installed for driver build (if driver needs DKMS).
- Persistent storage: CSI driver for your cloud or local PVs. 50GB free on local SSD for artifacts.
- Time / NTP: NTP in sync.
- DNS: cluster DNS resolution must reach external endpoints if using hosted registry; otherwise we need an offline mirror.
- Ports: allow outbound 443 to our control plane for telemetry and licensing checks OR provide mirrors; inbound only to bastion.
- RBAC: cluster-admin for the installer serviceaccount or give the person doing install cluster-admin.

mike_sre: Commands to verify on their nodes (paste to them):
```
# check GPU & driver
ssh node-1
nvidia-smi
modinfo nvidia
# check CUDA
ldconfig -p | grep cuda
# check container runtime
crictl info || docker info
# check kernel headers
uname -r && ls /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build || echo "kernel headers missing"
# check k8s version
kubectl version --short
# check node allocatable for GPUs
kubectl get nodes -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,GPU:.status.allocatable.nvidia.com/gpu
```

raj_eng_infra: Networking/ports specifics from our side (short):
- Outbound: 443 (control plane & package metadata), 443 to S3 endpoints if using our hosted model downloads.
- Inbound: 22 (bastion), 8443 (installer callback on bastion) — but we prefer installer to be initiated from bastion with outbound only.
- Internal cluster: allow kubelet <-> apiserver comms, DNS (53), etc.
- If SR-IOV or MIG is used, confirm NIC + GPU partitioning configs.

lena_field_se: Air-gapped notes: we provide an offline bundle and an installer that hits a local registry. Requirements: 
- Local registry reachable from cluster, TLS certs for registry.
- Mirror our artifacts (we'll give list + tarball).
- Bastion with internet to download bundle or upload logs.
- KMS: for Vault integration we need API endpoint reachable from control-plane/bastion and a cert for vault.

raj_eng_infra: Quick sample node selector + taint guidance for GPU nodes we recommend they prepare: 
```
# label GPU nodes
kubectl label node node-1 redwood.io/gpu=true
# taint so only workloads scheduled explicitly
kubectl taint nodes node-1 redwood.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule
```

mike_sre: Security checklist items for their compliance team: 
- Provide CSR or certs for installer (we can use mTLS).
- Audit logging enabled (we'll send guidance).
- KMS/HSM integration plan (Vault policies, service principal).
- Network diagram showing isolated VPC, bastion, and any peered networks.

ben_sales: On the hosted API key fallback: we can provide a scoped demo API key limited to prompts and traffic for 2 weeks. It will be rate-limited. Is that acceptable for FinBank?

alice_finbank: yes that helps for functional tests while offline mode is sorted. We'll also need a written data handling statement for the POC (where logs go, retention).

lena_field_se: I'll draft the short POC T&Cs for logs/retention. Also attaching a minimal runtime preflight script you can run (we'll provide as a gisted script too):
```
# preflight.sh (minimal checks)
# expects kubectl + ssh access
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -o name); do echo "CHECK $n"; kubectl describe $n | egrep "Kernel|Container Runtime|nvidia"; done
ssh node-1 'nvidia-smi || true'
```

raj_eng_infra: Action items: 
- Raj + Alice to run preflight on Tue (i'll schedule 10am PT).
- Lena to send offline bundle list + POC T&Cs by EOD.
- Mike to share audit logging guide and required RBAC snippets.
- Sales (Ben) to request demo API key and send data handling statement template to Alice.

alice_finbank: thanks — i'll confirm access windows and share SSH jump user.

deploy-bot: Installer run scheduled by raj_eng_infra for 2025-11-10T17:00:00Z (placeholder).

ben_sales: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the FinBank SOC contact and loop back after the preflight. :thumbsup:
